# @aponiajs/mcp

> Model Context Protocol server and tool registry for AponiaJS, with handshake version negotiation, `server/discover`, and structured tool output.

`@aponiajs/mcp` provides a lightweight implementation of the Model Context Protocol powered by JSON-RPC 2.0. It answers the handshake versions `2024-11-05` through `2025-11-25`, echoes the version a supported client asks for, and answers `server/discover` for a client that follows the `2026-07-28` revision.

## What this package exports

- [McpServer](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/server/mcp-server.ts): the server, its tool registry, version negotiation, and `server/discover`.
- [McpToolRegistry](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/tools/tool-registry.ts): registration, descriptor listing, and tool dispatch.
- [defineMcpTool](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/tools/define-tool.ts): a frozen tool declaration with input and optional output schemas.
- `McpResourceRegistry` / `defineMcpResource`: publish readable resources and answer `resources/list` and `resources/read`.
- `McpPromptRegistry` / `defineMcpPrompt`: publish prompt templates with typed arguments and answer `prompts/list` and `prompts/get`.
- [MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/protocol/protocol.constants.ts): the fallback handshake version (`"2024-11-05"`).
- [MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/protocol/protocol.constants.ts): every handshake version the package answers.
- [createStatelessHttpHandler](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/server/http-handler.ts): the readiness document, JSON-RPC POST handling, and protocol header checks.

## Behavior a consumer can rely on

- `initialize` echoes a supported requested version and falls back to `2024-11-05` otherwise.
- `server/discover` requires the request `_meta`, client capabilities, and a supported version when one is stated.
- `tools/list` publishes each tool's `outputSchema` when it declares one; `tools/call` passes `structuredContent` through unchanged.
- `resources` and `prompts` capabilities appear only when the server has an entry for them; a failed read or prompt build answers a generic error.
- A stateless request that states one version in `Mcp-Protocol-Version` and another in `params._meta` is refused.
- Standard error codes follow JSON-RPC 2.0: parse (`-32700`), invalid request (`-32600`), unknown method (`-32601`), invalid params (`-32602`), internal (`-32603`).
